tvShow.name: Atashin'chi
tvShow.overview: A light hearted comedy based on the about the daily life of a "normal" Japanese family. The Tachibana family consists of a housewife mom, a salary-man dad, and teenager Mikan and Yuzuhiko.

Yuzu and Mayonnaise
episodes.overview: Yuzu gets hungry at night and has an incident with mayonnaise.

episodes.name: Underwear Maketh Woman?

episodes.name: Mother's Selective Brain

episodes.overview: Father buys a computer and proceeds to have various issues with it.

episodes.name: Mikan, nap time!
episodes.overview: Mikan discusses her problems sleeping, including just taking a "Small nap" before getting back to her homework.

episodes.name: Mother Likes Bargains
episodes.overview: Episode 195: Mother discusses her bargain shopping for clothes.

episodes.name: Summer Break Organizing
episodes.overview: Mother wants to clean the house while father is away. Her children are very reluctant to help.

episodes.name: Come when you're called!
episodes.overview: Mother is annoyed when her children won't respond right away when called for dinner.

episodes.name: I'm Late!
episodes.overview: Mikan is repeatedly late for her dentist appointment.

episodes.name: A Future Comedian
episodes.overview: Mikan discusses her future potential at being a comedian.

episodes.name: So Noisy!
episodes.overview: A loud television causes problems for Mikan and Mother.

episodes.name: Chichimawasu?
episodes.overview: Hearing strange dialect, Mikan is determined to figure out what "Chichimawasu" means!  (For the purpose of this episode, the English title is in romanji)

episodes.name: Christmas For The Bear Brigade
episodes.overview: Mikan has to get a Christmas gift for her friends on a set budget.

episodes.name: Father Struggles with a Pain Relief Patch
Mikan, do I look ugly?
episodes.overview: After a couple get together, Mikan and her friends begin to wonder what makes a woman beautiful to men.

episodes.name: The Air Conditioner is Broken
episodes.overview: A broken air conditioner leads to many bizarre situations in the intense heat.

episodes.name: Mikan Is Stiff
episodes.overview: Falling asleep in her chair, Mikan finds herself waking up with a stiff back which causes many problems throughout the day.

episodes.name: Mother Tries to Remember Someone
episodes.overview: At a supermarket, mother encounters a familiar face and struggles to recall who she is.

episodes.name: Mikan Wants to Eat More
episodes.overview: Mikan is hungry at school and wants to eat plenty of food, but wants to watch her calories.

episodes.name: Yuzuhiko's Mechanical Pencil
episodes.overview: Kawashima admires Yuzuhiko's cherished mechanical pencil. Kawashima purchases the same mechanical pencil but isn't satisfied and eventually eyes Yuzuhiko's mechanical pencil.

episodes.name: Mikan's Handmade Hamburger Steak
episodes.overview: Mother is off on a two-day trip with friends and with Mikan in charge of dinner, she shows off her skills, determined to make a good meal. How will Father and Yuzuhiko react?

episodes.name: Jogging with Mother
episodes.overview: Mother accepts the fact that exercise is very important for your health. She resolves to start jogging but runs into a couple of obstacles along the way...

episodes.name: Father's Drowsy Drive
episodes.overview: Mother and Father are on the road. On the highway, Father is drowsy, so Mother tries to keep him awake in any way she can. What's the ultimate solution?

episodes.name: Mikan's Student ID Photo
episodes.overview: It's hard to look good in a photo. Mikan and her classmates are taking student ID photos and everyone is trying to look good. How will the photos turn out?

episodes.name: Yuzuhiko and a Melon
episodes.overview: Yuzuhiko, in awe at the rare sight of a melon at home, comes up with the ultimate plan to eat a whole melon himself...

episodes.name: Mother and Father's Hectic One-Night Trip
episodes.overview: Mother and Father visit a hot spring. On the way, Mother wants to check out some must-see spots. Afterwards at the the inn, they find themselves in a bit of hot water.

episodes.name: Bathroom Dreams
episodes.overview: Mikan and the Teddy Bear Brigade are chatting away about "bathroom dreams." What kind of strange dreams did they have?

episodes.name: Kawashima's Lonely Summer Break
episodes.overview: Kawashima is sad she can't see Yuzuhiko, so she rides her bike around the neighborhood, hoping to run into him. Meanwhile, Yuzuhiko happens to be shopping nearby.

episodes.name: Going to the Movies With Iwaki
episodes.overview: Hearing news that Yoshioka and Iwaki are going to watch a movie together, Mikan wants to tag along while Shimizu doesn't. They share their inner thoughts via "telepathy."
